CloudEventFilterDefinition.description:
A filter in the CloudEvents Subscriptions dialects: one key, the dialect, with its expression

Declared without the recursion of {@link Filter} so the configuration schema stays finite: the
nested filters of `all`, `any` and `not` are the same objects.

any.description: Filters of which one must match

exact.description: Attributes that must equal the values: `{ "type": "com.acme.order.created" }`

not.description: A filter that must not match

prefix.description: Attributes that must start with the values

sql.description: A CloudEvents SQL expression: `type = 'com.acme.order.created' AND subject LIKE 'eu-%'`

suffix.description: Attributes that must end with the values

Record<string, string>.description: Construct a type with a set of properties K of type T

Record<string, unknown>.description: Construct a type with a set of properties K of type T

bearerToken.description: Shared bearer token required in `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on incoming requests

dedupe.description:
Acknowledge an event already handled with the same `source` and `id` without dispatching it again

Delivery is at-least-once: the sender retries an event it did not get a 2xx for, so a handler that
succeeded but whose response was lost runs twice. The cache is in memory and per replica: it only
covers the retries reaching the same replica, keep the handlers idempotent.

dedupeSize.description: Entries the `dedupe` cache keeps, the oldest are evicted first

dedupeTtl.description: Milliseconds a handled `source` + `id` is remembered by `dedupe`

filters.description:
Filters every event must match to be dispatched, in the CloudEvents Subscriptions dialects:
`exact`, `prefix`, `suffix`, `all`, `any` and `sql` (CESQL)

An event not matching is acknowledged (202) without reaching the handlers.

requireAuthentication.description: Require an authenticated Webda session on incoming CloudEvent HTTP requests

strict.description:
Strict validation of the received events: `specversion` must be `1.0`, the required attributes
non-empty and the optional ones well-formed (`time` RFC3339), on top of the SDK validation

Loose by default: the required attributes (`specversion`, `type`, `source`, `id`) must be strings.

url.description: Path of the `POST` route receiving the events

broker.description: Name of the Broker, for the default `brokerUrl`

brokerUrl.description: URL of the Broker ingress the events are posted to

headers.description: Headers added to the requests to the Broker, like an `Authorization`

namespace.description: Namespace of the Broker, for the default `brokerUrl`

receiver.description:
Name of the `Webda/CloudEventsReceiver` service the consumers register on

A Knative `Trigger` on the Broker must deliver to its route (the `Webda/KnativeDeployer`
`triggers` parameter creates it).

timeout.description: Milliseconds before a request to the Broker is aborted
